usedFor: JobNimbus holds your estimates, and Google Docs receives the details when “New Estimate” runs “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Estimate” in JobNimbus, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A new estimate is written into a Google Docs tab, so the estimate text is on hand to edit.

watchOut: “Task Created Modified or Deleted” fires on edits and deletions too, so one task can run the template several times.
